conditions.junction: ballistic bulk Si perfect crystal, transport (100); device and both leads the same crystal
conditions.lead: transverse 8x8 conventional cells (4.34 nm), 512 atoms per slice, Tersoff (1989) potential, cutoff 5.6 A, a0 = 5.4321148 A
conditions.precision: frozen eskm reference output (eskm commit cc5a5fc1); MESCAL reproduces it on the CPU complex128 path (source of truth; GPU complex64 is the fast path, within 1e-3 of CPU)

source.detail: Phonon transmission of bulk Si along (100) at 0.05 THz from MESCAL mode matching (8x8 conventional-cell leads, Tersoff potential), 2.99992757 on the three open acoustic channels, 7.24e-5 below the ballistic staircase value 3; the full per-atom transmission curve matches the bulk curve of I. Duchemin, D. Donadio, Phys. Rev. B 84, 115423 (2011), Fig. 4, to within digitization noise (mean absolute deviation 0.013 per atom), doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.84.115423.
